title: Signal Postcards
subtitle: Dispatches from the Room
objective: Participants collect one simple environmental or behavioral signal from the room, convert it into a postcard-sized data visualization, and send one evidence-based recommendation to a future user of the space.
takeaway: A stamped 4×6 Signal Postcard plus an optional Signal Dispatch Receipt.
workplace: Connects to workplace design, store layout, guest experience, data storytelling, and observation as a design practice.
quick: Measure sound or light at 3–5 points and turn the readings into a dot map.
sixty: Add a message to a specific recipient, photograph the postcard, and place it in a shared gallery.
artifact: 4×6 postcard with front-side data artwork and back-side addressed message.

title: FPV Flight School
subtitle: Simulator Stick Skills for Calm Hands
objective: Participants learn the basic control logic of FPV flight through simulator drills and record one skill goal for future practice.
takeaway: A Pilot Card with hover, gate, reset, and personal-best notes.
workplace: Connects to simulation, training systems, risk reduction, embodied practice, and calm recovery after failure.
quick: Complete hover, reset, and one clean gate.
sixty: Add a three-gate route and optional team relay.
artifact: Pilot Card documenting the first controlled flight attempt.

title: Sound Logo Sprint
subtitle: Make a Tiny Brand Sound from Everyday Objects
objective: Participants create a 5–10 second sound logo using Foley, rhythm, layering, and editing.
takeaway: A short audio clip or cue sheet for a sound logo.
workplace: Connects to brand experience, emotional design, accessibility, media literacy, and listening as a design skill.
quick: Record three sounds and arrange them into a 5-second cue.
sixty: Add one synthetic sound, one silence, and a title card.
artifact: 5–10 second sound logo with title and design intent.

title: Robot Mood Machines
subtitle: Design Behavior, Not Just Motion
objective: Participants remix a prebuilt LEGO Spike robot behavior to express a chosen mood, service style, or personality.
takeaway: A tiny robot performance and a Behavior Card.
workplace: Connects to UX, service design, automation, interaction design, and the emotional layer of technology.
quick: Choose a mood and adjust speed, pause, turn, light, or sound.
sixty: Add one sensor-triggered behavior and a short demonstration.
artifact: Robot behavior performance plus Behavior Card.

title: Dimension Token
subtitle: Rapid STL Sprint + Live Print Conversation
objective: Participants create a tiny dimension-controlled 3D model, export an STL, and watch one or more pieces print live while discussing constraints, iteration, and file-to-object workflows.
takeaway: Exported STL, Dimension Card, and live/queued printed token.
workplace: Connects to rapid prototyping, dimensional communication, packaging/fixture/product thinking, QA, manufacturing constraints, and file-to-object workflows.
quick: Create a 30 × 18 × 3 mm token from a prepared template, export the STL, and watch one clean file print live.
sixty: Create/export tokens, slice a live batch, compare CAD view to slicer preview and first printed layers, then complete a Dimension Card.
artifact: Dimension-controlled STL file plus Dimension Card; live print sample or queued print card.

title: Tiny Code Creatures
subtitle: Prototype a Pocket Interaction
objective: Participants create a simple micro:bit creature that responds to buttons, shake, or tilt.
takeaway: An interactive micro:bit creature plus a Creature Card.
workplace: Connects to prototyping, interaction design, accessibility, input/output logic, and playful product thinking.
quick: Button A and Button B show two different moods.
sixty: Add shake or tilt behavior and a simple physical shell.
artifact: Interactive micro:bit creature with named input/output mapping.

title: AI Workflow Arcade
subtitle: Novel AI Toolchains for Practical Human Judgment
objective: Participants build and critique a tiny AI-assisted workflow from brief to sources to model output to verification and human decision.
takeaway: An AI Workflow Card with toolchain, source, output, verification, and human decision notes.
workplace: Connects to practical AI workflows, source discipline, structured outputs, generated assets, privacy boundaries, verification gates, and human-in-the-loop judgment.
quick: Run a three-station workflow arcade: source-aware answer, generated/structured output, verification desk.
sixty: Add local-vs-hosted model comparison, transcript-to-action, or agent/automation sketching.
artifact: AI Workflow Card with keep/check/reject marks and one human approval decision.
